title: Section-universe module restriction to a scheme chart
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ fibred in groupoids, and $a:h_U\to F$ a functor over this base for an $S$-scheme $U$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Give $F$ its big fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site] and regular-function structure sheaf [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. Its section-universe version $\mathcal O_F^{\rm sm}$ has value $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ at an object over $T$, with the usual restrictions, without the ambient-universe lift. Module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over this sheaf have the same local-presentation quasi-coherence predicate [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Define restriction to the chart by $M|_a(W)=M(a(W\hookrightarrow U))$ for Zariski opens $W\subset U$, with scalars through the canonical regular-function comparison, restrictions induced by open inclusions, and every module map evaluated on these objects. This is a functor to $\mathcal O_U$-module sheaves. The coefficient and additive sheafification conditions, also on every slice, hold in the scheme section universe; the module category has the canonical sheafified tensor product and symmetry [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and ambient cokernels given by sheafified sectionwise cokernels. The site object, site arrow and scheme universes remain independent. For a scheme morphism $f:T\to V$, also define global-section pullback and, for $W\subset V$, the open-section map from the unit of the section-normalized adjunction for $f^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], followed by restriction from $f^{-1}(V)$ or $j^{-1}(W)$, where $j:W\hookrightarrow V$, to the whole source. Define $f^*\mathcal O_V\simeq\mathcal O_T$ by left-adjoint uniqueness from this adjunction and the ordinary pullback adjunction, followed by its regular-module comparison.
